objective: Make longterm-mem promotion independent of the memory store: one memory model whose identity is a source plus a source id, one promotion walk and one propagation walk, each store (Engram, memorycard) an adapter, vault pages carrying a store-agnostic identity, and the hook-driven sync reading its source from configuration, per odd/tasks/phase9-store-agnostic-promotion.md.
scope: The specs of odd/tasks/phase9-store-agnostic-promotion.md, as the shaper writes them and the owner decides them; one workflow per task.
constraints: Every commit is reviewed or exempted, and labdrian review check clears it.
Only the owner runs anything against the live vault or the live memorycard store; every data migration is rehearsed on copies first.
Push, pull request and merge are the owner's decisions.
non_goals: Changes beyond what the specs and the review findings require.
acceptance_criteria: Every task of odd/tasks/phase9-store-agnostic-promotion.md is checked off with its commits.
labdrian review check --onto main clears the head of each pull request.
runtime_scope: Claude Code, as the parent that runs the labdrian workflow and the role agents.
delivery_boundary: Work-unit commits on feature branches; push, pull requests and merges remain the owner's decisions under ordinary repository policy.
